integrity: The result is an analytical derivation with exact rational coefficient checks; numerical checks do not certify the infinite theorem. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite strictly positive species probabilities and iid with-replacement samples. Eventual positivity, not uniform finite-sample positivity; no growing alphabet, field spatial dependence or finite-sample confidence coverage.
title: Rarest-taxon asymptotics for the covariance of observed richness and Shannon diversity
